cl.x: Provide SikaRapid® AF where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2023, Version 01.03).
SikaRapid® AF is a non chloride set accelerator for concrete and mortar.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: SikaRapid® AF is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where accelerated setting time is required. As a result, SikaRapid®-AF allows:
s: Faster finishing of concrete surfaces.
Improved early strength of premixed concrete.
Faster slip-form movement.
Used in ready mix concrete in cold weather.

cl.x: Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

r: Dosage is 400ml - 2000ml/100 kg of total cementitious material. Exact dosage rate should be determined by site trials.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Compatibility
cl.x: SikaRapid® AF can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika plasticiser or superplasticiser. It is beneficial to add SikaRapid® AF with the initial mixing water before the addition of superplasticiser to enhance strength development. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum combination. Do not useSikaRapid® AF in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admixtures.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Dispensing
cl.x: SikaRapid® AF is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid® AF may also be added into the agitator truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging.

s: Frozen SikaRapid®-AF may be used after it has been carefully thawed at room temperature and thoroughly stirred.
Where concrete with low cement content is being supplied, higher dosage rates should be used.
